rules.rule: Separate the sourcing detail read snapshot and entity/read generations from manual price proposals, while retaining existing current and read-only history UI.
rules.source: Approved full Pro Architecture Governance V1.1 section6 C and F3, coordinator inline architecture-work-handoff-cd36f84 section3, plus explicit coordinator follow-up allowing optional target address in the existing leave guard with backward compatibility, no new route algorithm or shared UI changes. User authorizes independent PR/Codex Review/sequential merges, no deployment/live data/configuration. Actual B947 merged deb3c93d4320552440bfe7603c9aae3de220f1ea, tree a13231ef175190f561fcd2c81b9df8b9a8a6a833 equals its passed candidate. rules.initialization: No schema, dependency, persistent draft, public route rewrite, eager import or CSS changes. OrderDetailPage is keyed only by actual case ID, within original session boundary. Read hook owns original seven validated GETs as one snapshot, entity epoch and independent monotonic read generation. Previous GET abort never cancels a POST. Current/failed/missing identity cannot submit; pristine proposals initialize before editing. Dirty manual fields, including explicit empty prices, are preserved on same-entity refresh/history, reset on another entity, and not stored globally or in localStorage. Original pricing, decimal/IME/cascade helpers and approved route/status applicability remain authoritative.
rules.dateAndPermission: No backend, field, date, quantity, amount, clock, authorization or workflow rule changes. Original AuthGate, Root and financial field rules remain; no token/query-string key or cross-user result cache. Timeline, attachment, factory, dispatch and contract facts remain original sources. Historical child contains no writable business forms or uploader; it is not a hidden editable page. Other entity data and stale read error/finally cannot paint current identity.
rules.expectation: Forced same-instance A-B-A read success/failure/finally and captured write-owner tests are explicitly controller tests, not onsite natural-route proof. Native full production App uses original signed AuthService/PostgresAuthStore and isolated native commands for real current-history-current and list-detail routes. Empty price plus reason survive natural same-order history navigation; another order has its own defaults. Existing role/layout/price tests and five original synthetic visual representatives, including mobile, retain business UI. Actual native 1440/1165 images are separately identified from synthetic layout screenshots.

rules.rule: Retain the original entity, immutable request, version and idempotency key for unknown sourcing submissions, and apply only owned acknowledgments without cancelling business writes.

rules.initialization: One page-level original submission feedback coordinator is reused, not replaced by new platform or per-button unknown-submit stores. IE/management, owner, finance, exception, contract, dispatch, budget correction, style and price-reapplication requests capture body/key before awaits. Existing expectedRevision/expectedVersion/document identifiers remain unchanged. Duplicate-style confirmation updates the captured body used for later recovery, not a new key. Management craft IDs are resolved once and retained; no later case mutation after losing owner. Contract-return files and original binding key survive retry; uploaded images use original recovery. No GET abort signal is used for business requests. Review P1 4508028771 is fixed with one existing coordinator rendered inside native return/budget/finance modals, never a second mutation store. Input/new-submit protections remain; internal recovery uses actual request busy rather than the blocked editing flag. Confirmed return uses same-entity read-back and existing internal navigation, avoiding full-refresh draft/beforeunload interference.
rules.dateAndPermission: Same-entity GET refresh does not invalidate a pending write owner. Success is marked before refresh; a later refresh failure cannot pretend rollback or issue another POST. Old entity success/failure/finally callbacks cannot alert/navigate/update a new mounted page. Unknown commit retains original request; permission/version checks remain server-owned. Optional targetHref is passed through original navigation and pop handling; no-argument guards keep compatibility. Same-entity chapters do not prompt; actual unsaved entity departure confirms once. Unknown or pending attachment submission stays on original entity for recovery. Confirmed finance/budget/proposal saves clear only their own dirty state.
rules.expectation: Native browser first commits a quote through original service/PG, then injects receipt503; recovery sends identical body/key twice and native database has exactly one quote. Attempted departure during unknown result remains on original order. Original failed/confirmed transfer tests now use real React effects and request/refresh behavior instead of state-cell-number mocks. Leave cancel retains the same order proposal; accepted leave and natural list navigation do not carry it to another order. Known successful POST followed by GET failure retains success and disables writes against the stale snapshot, with GET-only retry available.

rules.initialization: New browser suite is mapped from actual sourcing detail paths, discovered by the existing native browser preparer, and uses shared bounded correctness test/hook configuration. Native fixture supplies actual dispatch and contract-return services as production wiring requires; original failed fixture reports are retained and do not count as passes. Five old source sentinels follow actual hook imports/implementations and preserve their business assertions; dynamic tests cover the extracted behavior. Existing layout runner only gains bounded failure JSON next to its original failure screenshot, no new report gate. Native isolated PG/schema lifecycle, browser/server/temp output cleanups are retained. Prior candidate034529ecebfdf2345b9fe8dc716129df6b3352cf passed299 targeted unit/routes,3native browser,62classification and5synthetic layouts. Those unchanged-scope results remain historical supporting evidence, not current-head reruns. This fix reruns only affected UI/recovery units and all5 native cases including2new real modal/one-stored-change regressions, types/lint/preflight/secret. No repeated broad unit/scale/layout matrix for a report change.
rules.dateAndPermission: No migration, backup, scene clock, production data, site configuration or shared layout changes. PERF04 lazy module identity and CSS order are unchanged; PERF09 list SQL/count/15-row enrichment is untouched, as are all other PERF and authority/time fixes. Current F6 document now names read/proposal/submission boundaries and approved narrow navigation adapter; F1/F2/receiving-page extraction remains explicitly not yet done. Rollback only C wiring, not B/A or performance/history.
rules.expectation: Final same-source unit, native PG/browser, types, lint, protocol, original preflight/secret and five representative layout results are pinned to actual inputs/logs. Native failures due missing optional service wiring were fixed in fixture, not by granting permissions or removing GETs. A preliminary empty-fill failure was original focus formatting/selection in browser automation, resolved by focusing before clearing; pricing input rules were not changed. Original synthetic layout runner requires production JSX build context; private runner initially forced test NODE_ENV and was corrected to production, with failed report retained. Neither local hardware nor synthetic layout images are represented as CI/onsite equivalence.
